# spatial-primitives.library: LocalOffset

```plato
//==
// # Spatial primitives
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - SpatialPrimitives — frame, axis, and disk-extent helpers
//  - Oriented-box and rounded-box bodies
//  - Capsule bodies
//  - Cylinder, pipe, cone, and frustum bodies
//  - Disk, triangle, and quadrilateral bodies
//  - Tetrahedron, wedge, and convex-volume bodies
//  - Sphere, shell, cap, and ellipsoid bodies
//  - Torus bodies

library SpatialPrimitives
{
    //==
    // # SpatialPrimitives — frame, axis, and disk-extent helpers
    //
    // The shared kernels every `spatial-*.library.plato` file is written in terms of: the
    // rotated-frame conversions, the centred axis-aligned box, the perpendicular
    // component of a vector about an axis, and the disk half-extents that make every
    // tight cylinder / cone / disk / torus box a one-liner.
    //
    // Conventions fixed here, and GOVERNING EVERY `spatial-*.library.plato` FILE. They
    // are stated because nothing executes these bodies before they ship:
    //
    //   * PLACED, not origin-centred: every solid carries its own Center / Apex /
    //     endpoints and its own Axis or Orientation. No body assumes the world frame.
    //   * SIZES ARE FULL EXTENTS, so every box body halves them; RADII are radii, and
    //     HEIGHTS are full heights.
    //   * A SOLID DENOTES THE FILLED REGION INCLUDING ITS BOUNDARY. `SurfaceArea` is
    //     therefore the area of the WHOLE boundary of that region: a cylinder's two caps
    //     are included, a spherical cap's flat cutting disk is included, a shell's inner
    //     surface is included. Where that choice is not forced it is restated on the
    //     body.
    //   * `Volume` and `SurfaceArea` are NON-NEGATIVE. `Tetrahedron` additionally offers
    //     `SignedVolume`, matching its declaration's stated sign convention.
    //   * CONTAINMENT is boundary-INCLUSIVE everywhere (every test is a `<=` on a
    //     distance or a coordinate), matching `IContainsPoint3D`'s doc.
    //   * `ClosestPoint` on a filled solid returns the query point itself when the query
    //     is inside, which `INearestPoint3D` explicitly permits. `Disk3D` and `Triangle3D`
    //     are flat patches, not solids, so theirs always land ON the patch.
    //   * BOUNDS are TIGHT unless a body says CONSERVATIVE. Three do: the two
    //     spherical-cap-like shapes, where a tight box needs an angular-extreme analysis
    //     these files do not attempt.

    //==
    // # Frame and axis helpers

    // The displacement from `center` to `point`, expressed in the frame rotated by
    // `orientation`.
    LocalOffset(center: Point3D, orientation: Quaternion, point: Point3D): Vector3D
        => center.Between(point).Transform(orientation.Inverse);

    // A displacement given in a rotated frame, mapped back onto world axes.
    WorldOffset(orientation: Quaternion, local: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => local.Transform(orientation);

    // The axis-aligned box centred on `center` with the given half-extents.
    CenteredBounds(center: Point3D, halfX: Number, halfY: Number, halfZ: Number): Bounds3D
        => (Point3D(center.X - halfX, center.Y - halfY, center.Z - halfZ),
            Point3D(center.X + halfX, center.Y + halfY, center.Z + halfZ));

    // The component of `v` perpendicular to the unit vector `axis`.
    PerpendicularComponent(v: Vector3D, axis: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => v - axis * v.Dot(axis);

    // The per-world-axis half-extents of a disk of `radius` whose unit normal is
    // `axis`: the support of the disk along world axis e is r*sqrt(1 - (axis.e)^2).
    // The building block of every tight cylinder / cone / disk / torus box.
    // https://iquilezles.org/articles/diskbbox/
    DiskHalfExtents(axis: Vector3D, radius: Number): Vector3D
        => (radius * (1.0 - axis.X.Square).Max(0.0).Sqrt,
            radius * (1.0 - axis.Y.Square).Max(0.0).Sqrt,
            radius * (1.0 - axis.Z.Square).Max(0.0).Sqrt);

    // The tight bounds of the disk of `radius` centred at `center` with unit normal
    // `axis`.
    DiskBounds(center: Point3D, axis: Vector3D, radius: Number): Bounds3D
    {
        var e = DiskHalfExtents(axis, radius);
        return CenteredBounds(center, e.X, e.Y, e.Z);
    }

    // A unit displacement of length `radius` in the direction of `v` projected
    // perpendicular to `axis`; the zero vector when `v` is parallel to `axis` (any
    // rim point is then equally extreme, and the caller adds the axial part).
    RadialSupport(v: Vector3D, axis: Vector3D, radius: Number): Vector3D
    {
        var perp = PerpendicularComponent(v, axis);
        return perp.MagnitudeSquared <= 0.0
            ? Vector3D.Zero
            : perp.Normalize * radius;
    }

    //==
    // # Oriented-box and rounded-box bodies
    //
    // Volume, surface area, bounds, centroid, containment, nearest-point and support
    // bodies for the types declared in `spatial-primitives.types.plato`. The frame helpers,
    // and the conventions governing every body here, are in the shared section above.

    //==
    // # Box3D
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuboid

    // Width times height times depth.
    Volume(b: Box3D): Number
        => b.Size.Width * b.Size.Height * b.Size.Depth;

    // 2 * (wh + wd + hd).
    SurfaceArea(b: Box3D): Number
        => 2.0 * (b.Size.Width * b.Size.Height
            + b.Size.Width * b.Size.Depth
            + b.Size.Height * b.Size.Depth);


    // TIGHT: the half-extent along a world axis is the sum of the three local
    // half-extents weighted by the absolute components of the rotated local axes —
    // the box's support function evaluated on that axis.
    Bounds(b: Box3D): Bounds3D
    {
        var f = b.Orientation.Basis3D;
        var hx = b.Size.Width * 0.5;
        var hy = b.Size.Height * 0.5;
        var hz = b.Size.Depth * 0.5;
        return CenteredBounds(b.Center,
            hx * f.X.X.Abs + hy * f.Y.X.Abs + hz * f.Z.X.Abs,
            hx * f.X.Y.Abs + hy * f.Y.Y.Abs + hz * f.Z.Y.Abs,
            hx * f.X.Z.Abs + hy * f.Y.Z.Abs + hz * f.Z.Z.Abs);
    }

    // True when the query, in the box's own frame, is within the half-extents on
    // all three axes. Boundary inclusive.
    Contains(b: Box3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var q = LocalOffset(b.Center, b.Orientation, point);
        return q.X.Abs <= b.Size.Width * 0.5
            && q.Y.Abs <= b.Size.Height * 0.5
            && q.Z.Abs <= b.Size.Depth * 0.5;
    }

    // The query point when it is inside, otherwise the query clamped to the box in
    // the box's own frame and mapped back to world.
    ClosestPoint(b: Box3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
    {
        var hx = b.Size.Width * 0.5;
        var hy = b.Size.Height * 0.5;
        var hz = b.Size.Depth * 0.5;
        var q = LocalOffset(b.Center, b.Orientation, point);
        var clamped = Vector3D(q.X.Clamp(-hx, hx), q.Y.Clamp(-hy, hy), q.Z.Clamp(-hz, hz));
        return b.Contains(point)
            ? point
            : b.Center + WorldOffset(b.Orientation, clamped);
    }
```
